[meta-muse-spark-1-1-system-card] BioTIER v1.
[meta-muse-spark-1-1-system-card] To assess refusal in biosecurity, we leverage the BioTIER v1 refusal evaluation.3 The benchmark comprises prompts spanning Select Agents, Biomedical Dual Use Research of Concern, and Catastrophe Avoidance risk categories (Figure 6).
[meta-muse-spark-1-1-system-card] We evaluate multilingual refusal on BioTIER and the internal chemicalagent benchmark across a combined set of the most commonly used languages on Meta services, reporting an average blended multilingual refusal rate.
[meta-muse-spark-1-1-system-card] We also evaluate robustness against a typical static adversarial attack portfolio (e.g., jailbreak personas, context injection, obfuscation, and transfer attacks) applied uniformly across prompts on both BioTIER and the internal chemical-agent benchmark.
[meta-muse-spark-1-1-system-card] 3 BioTIER is available upon request at ai@securebio.org.
